title: Paprika dashboard AI and workflow design studies

studies.title: Service evidence desk
studies.description: Initial service-investigation composition with dominant latency evidence and a docked inspector. Superseded for implementation by studies 05 and 06.

studies.title: Shared time signal room
studies.description: Initial dark shared-time composition. Retained as exploration history; use studies 05 and 06 for the reconciled fixture.

studies.title: Capacity ledger
studies.description: Initial resource capacity ledger. Retained as exploration history; use study 07 for common-scale memory/request semantics.

studies.title: Inspection and reflow
studies.description: Initial keyboard, touch and reflow study. Retained as exploration history; use study 08 for evidence-preserving state continuity.

studies.title: Service investigation Light
studies.description: Revised Light service investigation: latest values at 10:30, selected values at 10:18, three missing minute samples and one docked inspector.

studies.title: Service investigation Dark
studies.description: Controlled Dark counterpart to study 05. Same composition, scope, time bounds, gaps, values and series identities.

studies.title: Memory request comparison
studies.description: Pod-grain memory used/request comparison with a shared 0–500% scale, full resource identities and distinct zero, absent-request, zero-request and unavailable-usage states.

studies.title: Mobile inspection and state continuity
studies.description: Mobile investigation ordering and selected-observation continuity through docking, reduced motion and accepted result replacement.

studies.title: Incident intelligence
studies.description: AI incident evidence canvas and hypothesis ledger. Observed evidence, working explanations and proposed tests remain distinct.

studies.title: Living system atlas
studies.description: Temporal service and revision atlas with stable spatial orientation, cohort evidence and explicit telemetry gaps.

studies.title: Recovery rehearsal
studies.description: Recovery branches with exact proposed changes, assumptions, prerequisites and verification. Conditional outcomes are not calibrated quantitative forecasts.

studies.title: Agent operations
studies.description: Supervision of bounded investigation agents: task states, evidence, disagreements, budgets and pause/cancel controls.

studies.title: Incident memory
studies.description: Historical incident retrieval with explained similarity, material differences and reusable investigation templates grounded in retained cases.

studies.title: Workflow Studio
studies.description: Workflow authoring with Canvas, Outline and structured source over one typed definition. Draft changes, fixture tests and immutable publication are separate actions.

studies.title: Action Definition workbench
studies.description: Reusable action definitions with typed inputs and outputs, target preconditions, supported adapters, effect semantics, fixtures and versioned publication.

studies.title: Run Inspector
studies.description: A durable run projection with pinned workflow/action versions, attempts, evidence, waits, operation receipts and verification results.
